name: Mamba Labs GTM Suite (npx)
description: Account intelligence for sales and go-to-market research: 21 tools for company identity, firmographics, social presence, hiring, tech stack, and funding signals, change monitoring, and ICP scoring, each run as a Mamba Labs actor on Apify with Clay-ready JSON output.

inputs.label: Apify API Token
inputs.description: Apify API token. Each tool call runs a Mamba Labs actor on your Apify account.

obtain.instructions:
1. Sign in to the Apify Console
2. Open Settings, then API & Integrations
3. Copy your personal API token

auth.instructions: Get an Apify API token at https://console.apify.com/account/integrations
